Agent Name: Verification_Expert  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Verification_Expert incorrectly concluded that no specific writer was quoted and treated the task as complete. In reality, Merriam-Webster’s Word of the Day page for June 27, 2022 (“jingoism”) does include a quotation with an attributed writer, so the verification step failed to properly check the source and led the conversation to the wrong solution.
